work_hours.label: Working hours
work_hours.description: Hold one limit while you work, and reach another by the time work ends.

after_work_limit.label: Limit after work
after_work_limit.description: Reached by the time work ends, and kept until it starts again.

tolerance.label: Arrival tolerance (%)
tolerance.description: How far short of a target still counts as on time. Smaller starts charging earlier.

learn_rates.label: Learn charging speed
learn_rates.description: Plan with the speed of your last few charges, from upower's history. Off: about 1 minute per percent below 80 %.
